summary: Challenging logic puzzles. Can you solve them all?
description:
Hashi is a challenging logic puzzle. Connect the islands with bridges so that all islands are connected as one group and the values correspond to the number of connected bridges. Each puzzle has exactly one solution, which can be found through logic reasoning. No guessing is needed!

While solving these logic puzzles can be tough, you can always check if your solution is correct so far and ask for a hint if you get stuck.

Solve these logic puzzles to challenge yourself, relax, exercise your brain, or simply pass the time. These puzzles offer hours of engaging entertainment! With difficulties ranging from easy to expert, there's something for puzzle enthusiasts of every skill level.

Are you up for the challenge? Can you solve them all?

Features:
- Check if your solution is correct so far
- Ask for hints (unlimited and with explanation)
- Works offline
- Dark mode and multiple color themes
- And much more...

Hashi is a grid-based logic puzzle that can be solved by logic only, similar to Sudoku or Kakuro. Hashi is also known as Hashiwokakero or Bridges. The puzzle is invented by Nikoli, a Japanese publisher that also invented the most popular logic puzzle of all: Sudoku. With Hashi, they have developed another puzzle that is at least as challenging and addictive as Sudoku.

All puzzles in this app are created by brennerd.
